scripts.dev: trap 'kill 0' EXIT; npm run dev:gateway & npm run dev:api & npm run dev:totem
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:totem
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @checkout/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @checkout/gateway && npm run typecheck --workspace @checkout/totem
scripts.dev:gateway-payments: trap 'kill 0' EXIT; npm run dev:gateway & PAYMENT_DRIVER=http npm run dev:api & npm run dev:totem
